missed.why: This is a seed in the R11 row (Research.md:289). P2 neither shortlisted nor dropped it. Datasheet SLVSDM5F, revised March 2020 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tlv7011.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:44:10Z). Supply 1.6 to 5.5 V. Push-pull output. tPHL 260 ns and tPLH 310 ns typical at 5 V with 100 mV overdrive; no maximum is stated. Both are far under the 21.8 µs limit. Common-mode range VEE to VCC + 0.1 V for VS 2.5 to 5 V, so 0 V is included. Internal hysteresis 1.2 / 4.2 / 14 mV (min / typ / max). The DBV pin order (1 OUT, 2 VEE, 3 IN+, 4 IN−, 5 VCC) matches TLV3201AIDBVR and MCP6561T-E/OT. TA −40 to 125 °C. Unlike TLV3201, its IN+ and IN− absolute maximum is VEE − 0.3 to 6 V, not referenced to VCC. TLV3201's inputs are diode-clamped at VCC + 0.5 V (SBOS561C, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tlv3201.pdf, read 15:44:55Z). The divided phase signal of a coasting motor can therefore sit on TLV7011's input while the 3.3 V rail is down without back-feeding the rail. JLCPCB C702117: stockCount 6136, canPresaleNumber 5959, extended, USD 0.5132 at qty 1 (15:44:00Z). With 2 placements the need is 10, so the gate is 50. The SC-70 TLV7011DCKR (C193688) has 7141 (15:44:00Z). Digi-Key TLV7011DBVR: 56359, Active, lead 16 weeks (15:44:46Z). TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/TLV7011 carries <meta name="status" content="ACTIVE"> (15:44:48Z)

The nanopower sibling of TLV7011, with the same DBV pin order (1 OUT, 2 VEE, 3 IN+, 4 IN−, 5 VCC). The "S" option uses a different pin order and is not this part. Datasheet SLVSE13J, revised November 2024 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tlv7031.pdf, read 15:44:10Z). Supply 1.6 to 6.5 V. Push-pull output. Propagation delay 3 µs typical, no maximum stated: 14 % of the 21.8 µs limit, the slowest of the candidates. Common-mode range VEE to VCC + 0.1 V. Hysteresis 2 / 7 / 17 mV. Input pins rated VEE − 0.3 to 7 V, not referenced to VCC. JLCPCB C2869832: 93875, presale 93792, USD 0.352 (15:44:01Z). Digi-Key: 4396, Active, lead 16 weeks (15:44:48Z). TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/TLV7031: status ACTIVE (15:44:48Z)

TI's low-voltage digital latch; P2 did not consider the family. Datasheet SLVSCY6B, revised January 2020 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/drv5011.pdf, read 15:40:13Z). VCC 2.5 to 5.5 V. Push-pull CMOS output: the 'push-pull from its own 3.3 V supply' option, with no pull-up needed. Sensing bandwidth 30 kHz, typical only. Delay 13 µs typical, 25 µs maximum. BOP 0.6 / 2 / 3.8 mT and BRP −3.8 / −2 / −0.6 mT; hysteresis 2 / 4 / 6 mT. It is a latch, so it holds its state with the rotor stopped. DBZ pins 1 VCC, 2 OUT, 3 GND: the same order as the DRV5015 and DRV5013 SOT-23 parts on P2's list. TA −40 to 135 °C (DBZ). It is less sensitive than rank 1 DRV5015A1 (2 mT against 0.7 mT typical). JLCPCB C2655023: 903, presale 898, USD 0.2899 (15:40:04Z); gate 50. The X2SON DRV5011ADDMRR (C2152499) has 1943 (15:40:05Z). Digi-Key DRV5011ADDBZR: 4122, Active, lead 9 weeks (15:40:27Z). TI page https://www.ti.com/product/DRV5011: <meta name="status" content="ACTIVE"> (15:40:41Z). Three other parts were checked and do not qualify. MLX92211LSE-AAA-000-RE (C3716263, 951 at 15:41:19Z; Digi-Key 0 at 15:41:25Z) states its BOP/BRP only for VDD 3.8 to 24 V. That was read from JLCPCB's copy of datasheet Rev. 010, December 2019 (https://jlcpcb.com/api/file/downloadByFileSystemAccessId/8590343539981774848, 15:41:48Z), after melexis.com answered HTTP 403 to all three clients (15:41:33Z to 15:41:39Z). Its thresholds at 3.3 V are therefore not stated. APS12205ELHALT (Allegro, 50 at 15:41:20Z) gives only an 800 kHz chopping frequency and no switching frequency, the same gap P2 found for A1220 (APS12205-15-35-DS Rev. 7, 15:42:29Z). MLX92212LSE-ABA is a unipolar switch, not a latch (MLX92212 datasheet, 15:40:41Z)

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: 5 V receivers (4.5 to 5.5 V in the jlcparts copy; datasheets not read): outputs at 5 V would need translation to 3.3 V (IOBoard.md:104, R11 concern on SN65LBC175); not qualified further
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: Translation is the route the page prescribes, not a failed value. The R11 row's concern reads "SN65LBC175 runs from 5 V; its outputs are translated to 3.3 V" (Research.md:289). IOBoard.md:104 requires translation of a 5 V output that can drive before the 3.3 V rail is up; it does not forbid the part. The family has two pin-compatible makers with large stock: AM26C32IDR (C36693) 134031, presale 133615 (15:49:22Z), and ST26C32ABDR (C157432) 7198, presale 7173 (15:49:24Z). The re-rank either qualifies them against the datasheet or states the value that fails. The translator and the 5 V supply count against them in the ranking. SN65LBC175 itself has at most 10 per row in the 2026-09-14 jlcparts copy; that was not counted at JLCPCB

For ROHM the manufacturer's page is the status and Digi-Key's figure is recorded as a distributor status. A product page without the status is recorded as not read and reported to the owner. Three ROHM product URLs answered 404 (15:47:54Z to 15:48:06Z). https://www.rohm.com/datasheet?p=RPR-220 answered 200 (15:48:07Z), with no status in the page body. ROHM's status is therefore not read, and Last Time Buy (Digi-Key, 15:37:30Z) is a distributor figure to report, not a failed gate. The part is still not qualified: the datasheet PDFs tried at fscdn.rohm.com returned HTTP 404 (15:48:27Z, 15:48:29Z), so the working distance at 5 mm is not read.
